(i) Preliminary identity. For every smooth vector field X on Omega with eta(n,X) = 0 one has nabla_X n = 0 if and only if theta(X,.) = 0 and omega(X,.) = 0; in particular, if theta = omega = 0 on an open set U then nabla_X n = 0 for every vector field X on U tangent to the rest distribution. (ii) Rotational case. Suppose omega is nowhere zero on a flow box U with adapted coordinates (s,y) and n = partial_s (thm-sr-local-congruence-adapted-charts-and-frobenius). Then the vorticity and the acceleration are basic (their components in the adapted coframe do not depend on s), d(a-flat) = 0 on U, and for any primitive F of the closed one-form a-flat on the star-shaped box U (thm-poincare-lemma-for-differential-forms-on-star-shaped-domains) the field K := exp(F) n is a timelike Killing field, nabla_a K_b + nabla_b K_a = 0, equivalently L_K eta = 0; if U is connected and simply connected with omega nowhere zero, a single positive smooth f on U satisfies L_{f n} eta = 0 (lem-sr-closed-one-form-primitive-on-simply-connected-open-sets). Conversely every future timelike Killing field on a connected open set, normalized as n = K/sqrt(-eta(K,K)), is Born rigid, and its flow is rotational exactly when its vorticity is nowhere zero. (iii) Irrotational case. Suppose theta = omega = 0 on Omega. Then on a sufficiently small neighbourhood U of every point the connected leaves of the rest distribution are open subsets of affine hyperplanes: there are a smooth future timelike curve z: J -> A with eta(z',z') = -1 and a smooth function sigma: U -> J such that, in the sense of the unique label, the leaves are the hyperplanes H_s = z(s) + z'(s)^perp, n = z' o sigma on U, N(x)=1+eta(z''(sigma(x)),x-z(sigma(x)))>0, d sigma(v)=-eta(z'(sigma(x)),v)/N(x), a = (z'' o sigma)/N, and nabla n = dsigma (x) (z'' o sigma); the tubular label has derivative 1 + eta(z'' o sigma, x - z o sigma), which is nonzero (taken positive) on U. Conversely, for every smooth future timelike curve z with eta(z',z') = -1 the field n := z' o sigma on any tubular neighbourhood on which the label sigma is unique with positive derivative is a smooth irrotational Born-rigid congruence with these same formulas. (iv) Scope. All statements are local on Omega; no global classification of rigid motions, no global orbit quotient, no completeness and no global restriction on the size of a rigid body is asserted beyond what the local formulas give. The rotational case is the local form of the Herglotz-Noether statement that a rotational Born-rigid motion is Killing; the irrotational case describes the orthogonal affine-plane families.
